subject.title: message send: 10s CLI→Gateway RPC timeout reports "Media failed" on large media that actually delivers (false negative + duplicate retries)

question: Should Gateway-owned message sends remain synchronous with a longer send-specific deadline, or return an accepted and trackable result while delivery continues?
rationale: A longer deadline is a bounded mitigation but cannot cover configured or reconnect-driven delays; an accepted/reconciled outcome changes public CLI result semantics and requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Track Send Completion
options.body: Return an idempotent accepted or unknown result with reconciliation so callers do not retry a send that remains in progress.

options.title: Raise Send Deadline
options.body: Use a longer timeout only for send actions as a near-term mitigation while retaining synchronous semantics.

recommendation.title: Track Send Completion
recommendation.body: Return an idempotent accepted or unknown result with reconciliation so callers do not retry a send that remains in progress.
